contacts_followup_idx.name: contacts_followup_idx
contacts_followup_idx.where: "contacts"."next_followup_at" is not null and "contacts"."discarded_at" is null

contact_has_channel.name: contact_has_channel
contact_has_channel.value: "contacts"."phone_e164" is not null or "contacts"."ig_username" is not null

account_identity.name: account_identity
account_identity.value:
("messaging_accounts"."channel" = 'whatsapp' and "messaging_accounts"."phone_e164" is not null and "messaging_accounts"."ig_username" is null)
     or ("messaging_accounts"."channel" = 'instagram' and "messaging_accounts"."ig_username" is not null and "messaging_accounts"."phone_e164" is null)
